description_en: Queries the information about top user agents of a website
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-user-agent --biz-region cn --domain www.example.com --start-time 1609430400 --end-time 1708352700 --limit 20 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopUserAgent

parameters.help_en:
The region in which your service is deployed. Valid values:

cn: a region in the Chinese mainland.
cn-hongkong: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
